task1.title: Request for Work Experience
task1.prompt: Write a letter to a company where you would like to do work experience. In your letter, you should introduce yourself, explain the type of work experience you are looking for, and specify how your skills and interests would benefit the company. Additionally, mention any relevant previous experiences or education that make you a suitable candidate for this position.

task2.title: The Impact of Technology on Communication
task2.prompt: In today's world, technology has revolutionized the way we communicate. Some people believe that this change has improved communication significantly, while others argue that it has had negative effects on personal relationships. Discuss both views and give your own opinion. Include specific examples to support your reasoning.
